sourceInputScope: Selected entry points plus mandatory full source-fingerprint checks before and after execution.

submissionEvidence.basis: Source review of frame_remote_externalities: only read-only chain/header/runtime-version/state-key/storage RPC methods; Executive hooks execute against local externalities.
submissionEvidence.scope: Zero submissions by the reviewed code path, not an independent network-traffic measurement.

coverage.featureClassification: Production chain feature selection plus common/test instrumentation from the chain-spec development dependency; not byte-identical production dependency behavior.
coverage.checks: Configured pre/post upgrade hooks, retained-state decoding, audited storage versions, complete bridge replay/index/bounds checks, and multi-block migration completion.
coverage.candidateBinding: Native source execution; pair with the separately hashed exact-Wasm fork rehearsal. This is not a deployment eligibility decision.

limitations: Native unit-test dependency unification enables common/test: FixedWrapper balance conversion uses stricter unwrap/checked behavior, and common include macros use test fallbacks. This is production chain feature selection with test instrumentation. Exact default-production Wasm fork execution establishes production runtime semantics.

No global try_state claim: System.Account, account balances/tokens, assets and unrelated pallets are omitted. Full Staking/XorFee retains real reward budgets, exposures and claims for migration hooks; it does not execute real user payouts.
Child tries are omitted because the selected migration paths use ordinary pallet/raw storage. This is not a complete chain-state snapshot or cryptographic state proof.
Legacy custom pallet data is omitted only after current pinned preflight verifies its no-op guard. Any guard/version mismatch aborts preparation and requires source/scope review.
Already-applied migration markers mean current-state replay exercises their idempotent no-op branch. Synthetic/native fixture tests separately cover active historical migrations.
The native runner uses a fresh scope-specific snapshot and rejects pre-existing cache files; a matching block hash alone does not prove filter completeness.
Public RPC responses are trusted for this diagnostic rehearsal. Finality/canonicality are provider assertions, not independent consensus verification.
No signed transactions, governance enactment, offchain-worker execution, full block consensus execution or validator deployment occurs.

nativeTestInstrumentation.meaning: common/test uses stricter fixed-point balance conversion and test include fallbacks; exact production semantics are checked by the separate default-production Wasm fork.
